hero.subtitle: From vulnerability to vanguard. We bridge bleeding-edge AI with bulletproof security infrastructure — before the threat shows up.

about.paragraph1: At Offensive Zone we bridge the gap between bleeding-edge artificial intelligence and bulletproof security infrastructure. From secure software development to global compliance readiness, we protect your digital assets before threats emerge.
about.paragraph2: We don't just defend pipelines: we understand the offensive methodologies used to break them. By combining an offensive mindset with tactical AI deployment and defensive engineering, we empower your organization to innovate fast, stay compliant, and scale without fear.

services.heading: Six fronts. One zone under control.
services.subtitle: Full coverage of the security lifecycle: from breaking your systems before anyone else does, to certifying to the world that you've already fixed it.

pentesting.title: Pentesting & Red Team
pentesting.description: We exploit your attack surface with the same techniques a real adversary would use — web, network, cloud, and social engineering — before someone without permission does it first.

secure-dev.title: Secure Software Development
secure-dev.description: We rebuild your traditional pipeline into a mature SSDLC: automated SAST/DAST, continuous threat modeling, and code reviews embedded in CI/CD, so security becomes a catalyst instead of a bottleneck.

ai-implementation.title: AI Implementation
ai-implementation.description: Future-proof operations, intelligently automated — from AI-assisted detection to internal copilots, with security controls designed in from the very first prompt.

cloud-audit.title: Cloud Security Audit
cloud-audit.description: We review configuration, IAM, and architecture across AWS, Azure, and GCP to close exposures before an automated scanner — or an attacker — finds them first.

compliance-prep.title: ISO 27001 / SOC 2 Readiness
compliance-prep.description: Navigate complex regulatory environments and unlock enterprise markets with confidence. We audit your infrastructure, align your processes, and build the rigorous documentation certification requires.

security-awareness.title: Security Awareness
security-awareness.description: We train your team to recognize and respond to threats — the human link stops being the weakest point of your perimeter.

methodology.heading: How we work a zone.
methodology.subtitle: Four phases, no shortcuts. Every assessment leaves traceable evidence, not just a PDF with generic findings.

phase1.title: Reconnaissance
phase1.description: We map your real attack surface: exposed assets, dependencies, and entry points your inventory doesn't know about.

phase2.title: Active assessment
phase2.description: We exploit vulnerabilities in a controlled way to demonstrate real impact, not just theoretical risk.

phase3.title: Action plan
phase3.description: We deliver findings prioritized by real business risk, with concrete remediation steps for your technical team.

phase4.title: Re-testing
phase4.description: We confirm every finding is actually closed — the zone isn't secured until we've checked it twice.

cyber-threats.title: Elevating the Fight Against Cyber Threats
cyber-threats.description1: At Offensive Zone, we take the battle against cyber threats to the next level. In an era where data breaches and cyberattacks are becoming increasingly sophisticated, our mission is clear: to safeguard your digital assets and protect your business from the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.
cyber-threats.description2: Partner with Offensive Zone and fortify your defenses against cyber threats. In an age where cybersecurity is non-negotiable, choose the experts who are dedicated to your protection and peace of mind.

cesar.name: Cesar Arreaza
cesar.bio: Penetration Tester & Security Researcher at Codefend. CEH certified, focused on OWASP Top 10, red teaming, and AI-assisted offensive workflows.

edgardo.name: Edgardo Krause
edgardo.bio: Lead Security Engineer at Qubika. 7+ years across web, mobile, network, and cloud (AWS) pentesting. Formerly PwC, EY. eCPPT and AWS Red Team Expert certified.

security-awareness.title: Security Awareness
security-awareness.description: Human error remains the leading vector for corporate breaches. We design and deploy comprehensive Security Awareness programs that transform your workforce into your strongest line of defense. Through realistic phishing simulations, interactive training, and behavioral metrics, we build a proactive culture of security.

ai-implementation.title: AI Implementation
ai-implementation.description: Accelerate your business evolution by seamlessly integrating Artificial Intelligence into your operational workflows. We develop, deploy, and optimize custom AI models and LLM infrastructures designed to maximize efficiency while strictly maintaining data privacy, model governance, and computational integrity.

secure-software-development.title: Secure Software Development
secure-software-development.description: We engineer high-performance software architectures with security embedded into their DNA. By eliminating vulnerabilities at the source code level, we deliver robust, scalable applications capable of withstanding sophisticated exploitation attempts without sacrificing user experience.
secure-software-development.tagline: Zero-trust architecture from the very first line of code.

iso-soc2-compliance.title: ISO 27001 / SOC 2 Compliance Readiness
iso-soc2-compliance.description: Navigate complex regulatory environments and unlock enterprise markets with confidence. We systematically audit your infrastructure, align your processes, and build the rigorous documentation required to achieve ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type I/II readiness with zero operational friction.

ssdlc.title: SSDLC (Secure Software Development Life Cycle)
ssdlc.description: Shift security to the left. We reconstruct your traditional development pipeline into a mature Secure SDLC. By embedding automated SAST/DAST testing, continuous threat modeling, and rigorous code reviews directly into your CI/CD pipelines, security becomes a natural catalyst rather than a bottleneck.
